direct_identifiers.note: No direct identifiers were found in the eight source fields. Staff first names appear in a few ledger-style free-text descriptions and are redacted on ingestion.

pseudonymous_identifiers.invoice_number: Transaction identifier; retained because it is the transaction key. It does not identify a person on its own.

present.treatment: HMAC-SHA256 keyed pseudonym (customer_key); raw id never leaves the restricted bronze zone

present: purchase basket composition / purchase history per customer_key
quasi_identifiers.risk: Combined with outside knowledge these could single out a customer, especially in small countries.

business_sensitive: bank-charge / bad-debt ledger lines (excluded from published tables)
sensitive_information.protected_characteristics: Not present and NOT inferred. Demographic fairness cannot be assessed from this dataset.
sensitive_information.special_category_data: Not present (no health, ethnicity, religion, biometric or similar fields).

pseudonymisation.accuracy_note: Pseudonymous, not anonymous; re-linkable by whoever holds the secret or raw ids.
pseudonymisation.method: HMAC-SHA256 keyed pseudonym, truncated to 32 hex chars
